entity_raw.definition_raw:
Stubborn, tenacious, and proud, you’re all but immovable when you have kin to back you up.

Prerequisite(s): Dwarf, hardy racial trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you fight defensively and you’re adjacent to an ally who also has this feat, your racial bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities increases by 2.
